title: climatology.py's even-spacing branch returns uniform weights for a bin pattern that is not uniform
description:
lib/climatology.py recovers a bin's raw record count from the SPACING of the bin centres, and takes a degenerate branch when the spacing is even. Its docstring argues that even spacing implies nbin divides the record count. THAT IS FALSE, and the counterexample is not exotic: counts that alternate about a constant pair sum have evenly spaced centres.

18 raw records in 12 bins gives counts [1,2,1,2,1,2,1,2,1,2,1,2]. Every adjacent pair sums to 3, so the centres are evenly spaced, the branch fires, and the function returns uniform 1/12 where the true weights alternate 1/18 and 2/18. A FACTOR OF TWO, returned without raising. The same holds for 30 records in 12 bins and for every ntimes near 1.5*nbin.

This is the module world-vwqw's two call sites reached with an index array, and the fix there was to hand it real bin centres. Real centres do not save this case: the branch is reached from correct input.

The current baseline is 182 records in 12 bins, which is not one of the affected patterns, so nothing measured today is wrong through this route. It is a trap for the next climatology whose record count lands near 1.5*nbin -- which a shorter clean-I/O block or a different writes-per-day easily produces.

world-vwqw's fixture DELIBERATELY EXCLUDES these cases and says why, so the gate asserts nothing false about them. Extending it is part of the fix.

Do: make the degenerate branch refuse rather than guess when it cannot distinguish a genuinely uniform binning from an alternating one, or recover the counts from something other than centre spacing. The issue's own earlier suggestion -- have bin_weights refuse monotone integers from zero -- belongs in this module too, since that is the shape an index array has.

Found by the world-vwqw sweep, which was not looking for it.
acceptance_criteria: lib/climatology.py either recovers the true counts for alternating bin patterns or refuses them explicitly; the smoke fixture covers 18-in-12 and 30-in-12 rather than excluding them; a monotone integer axis is refused at the boundary.
close_reason: Resolved and committed. world-2jj3: _logcollected reads back what the iteration stored, fixed at all four sites; four codes bound their own name, not three, and 100 ilibrary codes with no arm could log the previous variable's shape under their own name. world-u0ck: run_67323a923013's raw recovered and re-converted to 1463 samples, the substituted 12-bin average kept beside it as evidence, INDEX.json carries a per-run high_cadence block, and no published number moved though the Weibull shape exposure was a factor of 1.94. world-jqm4: an evenly spaced axis over an even bin count is genuinely ambiguous -- 36 records at dt 160 and 18 at dt 320 give a bit-identical axis -- so it refuses, with a checked ntimes declaration as the door.

comments.author: Conor Futro
comments.text:
Counterexample verified, and the ambiguity is worse than "cannot be recovered":
the two binnings stamp the IDENTICAL axis. 36 records written every 160
timesteps and 18 written every 320 both give the twelve centres 319, 799, 1279,
... exactly, because the write interval is the unknown common factor. So no
argument from the file recovers the count, the absolute offset included.

General condition: evenly spaced centres say every adjacent PAIR of bins holds
the same total, not that the bins are equal. pyburn's linspace truncation gives
counts taking only k and k+1, so a constant pair sum has two shapes, all-k and
alternating k, k+1. The alternating shape is what ntimes = nbin*(2m+1)/2
produces for whole m, whenever nbin is EVEN: 18, 30, 42, ... in 12 bins;
24, 40, 56, ... in 32. Enumerating to 3000 records shows this is the ONLY
ambiguous class: every other record count inverts uniquely, so the early return
outside the degenerate branch was sound.

Disposition: REFUSE, with a checked declaration as the door. lib/climatology.py
now enumerates the record counts an evenly spaced axis is consistent with and
asks whether they agree about the WEIGHTS. For an even nbin they never do, so it
raises and names the witness; for an odd nbin only the equal shape exists, so the
weights are determined and nbin is still returned. bin_weights, annual_mean,
annual_mean_of and masked_mean take an optional `ntimes` for a caller that holds
the record count from the run, and the declaration is checked against the centres
before use. bin_counts is the new public entry. A bin axis of integers from the
time origin, index-shaped, is refused in the module with its own message.

Nothing measured today changes: every regular climatology in the tree is 182
records in 12 bins and weights identically before and after.

Follow-up worth a bead: exoplasim/scripts/build_climatology.py calls
bin_weights on each MOST file's time axis, and the first files of most runs are
NLOWIO = 1 spin-up orbits with evenly spaced centres, which now refuse instead of
returning equal weights. That is the intended answer today, since a climatology
binned from that regime is separately tainted and its consumers already refuse
it, but if such a product is ever wanted the script should declare the record
count from the run's write interval and orbit length rather than the module
guessing it.

title: No LPJ run has equilibrated, and the record that would judge one is thirty times what has been run
description:
EVERY LPJ-GUESS run this project has made fails its own BIO-12/BIO-14 acceptance gate on the same refusal, and nothing tracked it. sdec-1 named the failure and put it out of scope; no row was filed.

  lpj_de621fd6 (Vesper, 997 cells)  FAIL  anpp.out still trending in TeNE, IBS, C3G, C4G, Total
  lpj_09e22558 (stock,  997 cells)  FAIL  same five
  lpj_183dca23 (Vesper, 1617 cells) FAIL  TeNE, IBS, C4G

THE TIME BASE IS CORRECT AND IS NOT THE CAUSE. This was checked and it is worth
recording so nobody re-checks it: vesper_pfts.ins sets nyear_spinup 998 and
freenyears 200, both deliberately doubled from LPJ-GUESS's 500 and 100 with the
conversion written in the comment. At 0.5010172 Earth years per orbit that is
500.0 and 100.2 Earth years, so the spin-up matches the community convention
exactly rather than falling short of it. The retained period is 100 simulation
years, 50.1 Earth years, and the acceptance window is its last 10 cycles.

The CENTURY accelerator is not obviously the cause either. SOLVESOMCENT_SPINBEGIN
and SPINEND are 0.1 and 0.3 of (nyear_spinup - freenyears) + freenyears, so the
analytic SOM solution lands around simulation years 280 to 440 and the ecosystem
has roughly 560 more spin-up years after it.

So after 500 Earth years of spin-up on a fixed repeated climate -- with no
forcing change to re-equilibrate to -- three to five PFTs still fail a mild test:
end-to-end relative change under 5 percent with a slope under 2 standard errors,
on at most 25 percent of cells, over the last 10 complete forcing cycles
(biosphere/config/equilibrium_window.yaml). THE CAUSE IS NOT ESTABLISHED.

WHAT THIS COSTS. The ntransform stock-versus-Vesper nitrogen comparison in
biosphere/analysis/ntransform_*.json rests on two runs that both failed
acceptance, and the comparison was written anyway. Its numbers -- gross
denitrification +20853 percent and the rest -- bound the divergence between two
arms that are equally far from equilibrium, which is weaker than the comparison
reads, and biosphere/notes/soil-nitrogen-transformation-parameterisation.md
presents it without that qualifier. It also blocks world-cp27's last two
initial-state fields, because build_surface_albedo.py calls
require_lpj_acceptance and will not read a refused run.

Do: first establish whether more retained time settles it, which is running now
as a 1000-orbit diagnostic against the same 998-year spin-up. If it does, the
retained period is the knob and its length wants deriving from an ecological
timescale rather than picking. If it does not, the trend is structural and the
candidates are the PFT parameterisation, the fixed-climate forcing replay, and
the accelerator's hand-off -- in which case the acceptance contract is telling
the truth and the biosphere is not at equilibrium on this world at all.
acceptance_criteria: An LPJ run on the current build passes vesper-lpj-acceptance/1 with no equilibrium refusal, its length is derived from a stated ecological timescale rather than chosen, and the ntransform comparison is re-taken on an accepted pair.

comments.author: Conor Futro
comments.text:
2026-08-30 MEASURED: THE GATE IS CONFLATING TWO FAILURES AND ONLY ONE OF THEM
IS AN EQUILIBRIUM PROBLEM.

A 1000-orbit diagnostic (lpj_377476c097b549fcaaa07cc7644275ad, 1617 cells,
npatch 5, same 998-year spin-up and seed) against the 100-orbit run
(lpj_183dca231e354f399fee49060960b1f8). Trend status per output file:

  file        100 orbits                    1000 orbits
  anpp.out    TeNE, IBS, C4G                none
  cmass.out   TeNE, IBS, C3G, Total         C3G, Total
  lai.out     TeNE, IBS, C3G, Total         TrIBE, C3G, Total
  cflux.out   none                          none

GLOBAL DRIFT CONVERGES WITH LENGTH. The spatial-mean end-to-end change is the
first half of the criterion, limit 0.05:

  TeNE  lai 0.1631 at 100 orbits -> not trending at 1000
  IBS   lai 0.0709, cmass 0.1463 -> not trending at 1000
  TrIBE lai 0.0552 at 1000, and NOT trending at 100 because it had not
        established yet. Marginal, just over the limit.

So the woody PFTs are equilibrating and the run length is a real knob for them.

THE CELL-FRACTION HALF DOES NOT CONVERGE, AND IT IS NOT MEASURING DRIFT.
C3G and Total fail only on "more than 25 per cent of cells are individually
trending", while their GLOBAL drift sits five to ten times inside the limit:

  lai C3G    global 0.0123 -> 0.0257    cells trending 0.376 -> 0.365
  lai Total  global 0.0054 -> 0.0057    cells trending 0.309 -> 0.290
  cmass C3G  global 0.0134 -> 0.0233    cells trending 0.307 -> 0.299

Splitting the cell test into its two conditions for lai C3G:

              over the 5% drift limit   over 2 sigma   both   median |drift|
  100 orbits          0.743                0.464       0.376      0.4150
  1000 orbits         0.722                0.451       0.365      0.3830

THE MEDIAN CELL'S GRASS LAI SWINGS 38 TO 42 PER CENT over ten cycles, against a
5 per cent limit, and a tenfold increase in retained time moves it by 0.03.
Those swings cancel in the spatial mean, which is why the global number is
tiny. That is spatially incoherent per-cell variability, not a global
transient, and a quantity that does not respond to a tenfold change in the
thing it is supposed to be testing is not testing it.

HYPOTHESIS AND THE TEST, pre-registered here before the run reports: the
variability is patch-scale gap dynamics averaged over only npatch 5 replicates
per cell. If so, raising the patch count reduces per-cell drift roughly as
1/sqrt(npatch) while leaving the spatial mean where it is. A npatch 20 run at
nyear 100, everything else identical to lpj_183dca23, is running now. Confirmed
means the cell-fraction refusal is an ensemble-size artifact and the fix is the
patch count, not the run length; refuted means the grass is genuinely migrating
cell by cell and the criterion is right to refuse.

EITHER WAY maximum_trending_cell_fraction: 0.25 in
biosphere/config/equilibrium_window.yaml is a round number with no derivation
recorded, which under the no-tuned-values convention is its own disposition to
settle. The null it should be set against is computable: what fraction of cells
does a 2-sigma slope test over 10 points flag in a stationary field. For pure
noise that is about 5 to 8 per cent, so 0.25 is not obviously wrong, but it was
not derived from that and the observed 0.37 is well above the null either way.

The time base remains correct and is not implicated: nyear_spinup 998 and
freenyears 200 are 500.0 and 100.2 Earth years.

comments.author: Conor Futro
comments.text:
2026-08-30 THE PRE-REGISTERED PREDICTION HELD, AND THE GATE STILL DOES NOT
CLEAR. Both halves of that are the finding.

npatch 20 against npatch 5, nyear 100, everything else identical
(lpj_36b0f5fc91a640ed94618b0e95420916 against lpj_183dca231e354f399fee49060960b1f8).
The prediction registered before the run was that per-cell drift falls roughly
as 1/sqrt(npatch), 0.50x for a fourfold patch count, and that the spatial mean
does not move.

  lai C3G                       npatch 5    npatch 20     ratio
  median per-cell |drift|         0.4150      0.2503      0.603
  window mean value              0.13178     0.13226     +0.36%
  lai Total window mean          1.31032     1.31264     +0.18%

So the mechanism is confirmed: the per-cell trend IS patch-scale gap dynamics
averaged over too few replicates, it falls with the patch count close to the
predicted rate, and the mean it is a trend in does not move.

BUT THE CELL FRACTION BARELY MOVES, 0.376 to 0.348, against a 0.25 limit. The
reason is now exact:

                            npatch 5   npatch 20    ratio
  median |drift|              0.4150     0.2503     0.603
  median relative slope SE   0.04191    0.02758     0.658
  cells over the 5% limit     0.743      0.724
  cells over 2 sigma          0.464      0.416
  cells over BOTH             0.376      0.348

THE DRIFT AND ITS STANDARD ERROR FALL BY THE SAME FACTOR. The significance test
is a ratio of the two, so it is invariant to the patch count: more patches make
the estimate more precise, which makes a smaller drift significant, and the two
effects cancel. Adding patches cannot clear this gate.

Neither can adding time. The 1000-orbit run moved the same cell fraction 0.376
to 0.365 while its global drift stayed five to ten times inside the limit.

SO BOTH KNOBS THAT SHOULD RELAX THIS CRITERION ARE INVARIANT TO IT, and that is
a property of how it is written rather than of this world's ecology. A test of
drift against its own standard error does not become satisfiable by reducing
noise, because it measures the ratio. What such a test CAN do is detect a
coherent trend, which is exactly what it does correctly on the woody PFTs: TeNE
and IBS cleared between 100 and 1000 orbits because their drift was real and
global, and their global end-to-end change is the half of the criterion that
responded.

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR THE ROW. maximum_trending_cell_fraction 0.25 needs deriving
against a null that includes the patch ensemble's own persistence, not against
an independent-samples null. For independent samples a 2-sigma slope test over
10 points flags about 5 to 8 per cent of cells; the observed 35 to 38 per cent
is far above that, and the gap is what the patch ensemble contributes. The null
is computable from the model itself: run two seeds at fixed forcing and measure
what fraction of cells the test flags when there is no trend to find.

Until that is done the gate refuses every run, which is why no LPJ output this
project has ever produced is accepted, and world-cp27's last two initial-state
fields stay blocked behind it.

Runs: lpj_183dca23 (npatch 5, 100y), lpj_377476c0 (npatch 5, 1000y),
lpj_36b0f5fc (npatch 20, 100y). The npatch 20 run's anpp refusal also narrowed
to TeNE and C3G from TeNE, IBS and C4G.

comments.author: Conor Futro
comments.text:
2026-08-30 PRE-REGISTERED, BEFORE THE NULL IS COMPUTED: HOW THE NULL IS BUILT AND
WHAT EACH OUTCOME DECIDES.

THE NULL NEEDS NO NEW RUN. The forcing cycle is one year (run_manifest.forcing
cycle_years 1, VESPDRV8, 12 intervals): every simulation year replays a byte-identical
forcing year. So all interannual variation in a retained series is internal model
stochasticity -- patch disturbance, establishment, fire -- and not forcing. The
1000-orbit diagnostic lpj_377476c0 is therefore already a 1000-cycle realisation at
literally fixed forcing on all 1617 cells, which is what the two-seed experiment was
proposed to buy. Cost of the null: reading four .out tables. No model run.

CONSTRUCTION.
 1. Source lpj_377476c0 (nyear 1000, npatch 5, 1617 cells). Per cell, per field, the
    annual series IS the cycle-mean series.
 2. Subtract a per-cell linear fit over all 1000 cycles, and add the per-cell full-window
    mean back so the relative-drift half is judged against the same scale the gate uses.
    This removes any genuine secular approach to equilibrium and leaves stationary
    internal variability, including the patch ensemble's persistence, which a permutation
    or independent-samples null destroys.
 3. Cut 100 disjoint 10-cycle windows. Apply lib/lpj_output.py's own per-cell test
    unchanged to each.
 4. Per window, take the MAXIMUM flagged-cell fraction over fields, because the gate
    refuses a run if ANY field exceeds the limit. The null distribution of a REFUSAL is
    that per-window maximum.

DERIVED VALUE D = the 95th percentile of that per-window maximum, rounded up to 0.01:
the level a genuinely equilibrated run exceeds in at most 5 per cent of windows.
Bracket: the 90th and 99th percentiles of the same distribution. Independent check:
the same statistic on the npatch-20 run's 10 windows, which must agree if the finding
that the ratio test is patch-count invariant is right.

DECISION RULE, FIXED NOW.
 - D <= 0.20 (null well below 0.25): threshold becomes D with its bracket. 0.25 is NOT
   retained for being safely above the null; it has no derivation and D has one. The
   observed 0.35-0.38 stays a refusal and the refusal is then real.
 - 0.20 < D <= 0.30 (null near 0.25): threshold becomes D. If D rounds to 0.25, the
   current value is retained and now carries a derivation, and the row closes on a
   derivation rather than a change.
 - D > 0.30 (null above 0.25): the limit sits below the test's own false-positive rate
   and the gate has been refusing equilibrated runs. Threshold becomes D -- UNLESS
   D >= 0.50, at which point the test flags a majority of cells with no trend present,
   has no usable discriminating power, and the disposition is a FORM change to the cell
   half rather than a number.

POWER, also fixed now and decided independently of D. Inject a coherent linear trend of
exactly the contract's own relative_end_to_end_limit, 5 per cent end to end, into every
cell of the detrended surrogate and re-run the test. P = median over windows of the
per-window maximum flagged fraction. If P/D < 2 the instrument cannot separate a run
drifting at the contract's stated limit from a run with no drift at all, and the
cell-fraction half is the wrong instrument whatever D is; the disposition is then a form
change with the argument recorded. If P/D >= 2 it discriminates and a threshold is the
right repair.

CONTAMINATION CHECK: the null flag fraction is also reported against window position. A
systematic fall from early to late windows means step 2 left residual drift and the
estimate is contaminated; that gets reported rather than smoothed.

THE DERIVATION READS NONE OF THE THREE RUNS' OBSERVED FRACTIONS. If D ends up above
0.348 or 0.376 and a previously refused run passes, that is a consequence and not an
input, and it is stated as such.

comments.author: Conor Futro
comments.text:
2026-08-30 THE NULL IS MEASURED, AND 0.25 SAT BELOW IT. The pre-registered rule's
power arm fired, the disposition is the form change it named, and the trending-cell
limit is now measured per field instead of declared. Evidence in
`biosphere/notes/equilibrium-trend-null.md`; contract is now
vesper-lpj-equilibrium-window/2.

COST OF THE NULL: no model run. The forcing cycle is one simulation year and every
year replays byte-identical forcing, so the 1000-orbit diagnostic was already a
1000-cycle realisation at fixed forcing. Reading its seven stability tables is the
whole experiment.

THE NULL, on the criterion as it was written, per-window maximum over fields, 100
detrended windows of lpj_377476c0:

    median 0.392   p90 0.450   p95 0.455   p99 0.461   maximum 0.462

The registered D was the p95 rounded up: 0.46. The npatch-20 check gives median
0.367 and maximum 0.383, so the null is near enough patch-count invariant as the
ratio argument predicts, and the flag rate is flat against window position, so the
detrending left no residual drift in the estimate.

The refusals were therefore not evidence of drift. Observed 0.376 and 0.365 for lai
C3G against a null median of 0.379; observed 0.309 and 0.290 for lai Total against a
null median of 0.298. All four inside the null's 95th percentile, three of four below
its median.

WHY THE THRESHOLD ARM WAS NOT TAKEN. The registered power arm fired -- power at the
contract's own drift limit was 0.563 against D 0.455, a ratio of 1.24 against the
registered 2 -- and the per-field breakdown says why a single number of any value is
the wrong object. The null is a per-field quantity spanning three orders of
magnitude, because it is set by the field's own internal variability and by how much
of the grid it occupies:

                          occupancy   null   power at 2x limit
    npool.out SoilN            1.00  0.001   0.998
    cpool.out SoilC            0.94  0.001   0.942
    lai.out   Total            0.93  0.298   0.552
    cpool.out VegC             0.90  0.387   0.605
    lai.out   TeNE             0.10  0.066   0.085
    lai.out   TeBE             0.24  0.119   0.184

Setting the limit to 0.46 for the grass and vegetation fields destroys it on the slow
soil pools, where it discriminates almost perfectly and where per-cell disequilibrium
is the real risk. A second defect is visible in the same table: the denominator was
every cell rather than the cells the field occupies, so five of thirteen plant
functional types could not reach a quarter-of-all-cells limit however hard they
drifted -- measured power at twice the contract's drift limit is 0.08 to 0.19 for
them. The guard was inert for nine types and permanently tripped for four.

WHAT THE CELL HALF WAS FOR, AND WHY IT IS KEPT. It is for opposed regional drifts
that leave the spatial mean flat, which the global half cannot see by construction.
The old form did not do that job: under a cancelling dipole at twice the drift limit
its flagged fraction was indistinguishable from its own no-drift value on the noisy
fields. It is kept and repaired rather than deleted.

THE REPLACEMENT, and it adds no number. Each field's limit is measured from the run
being judged: the record before the acceptance window is detrended cell by cell, cut
into windows of the contract's own length, and the field's limit is the largest share
of its OCCUPIED cells any of those windows flags. The acceptance window is judged
undetrended, so a drift present throughout the record is removed from the reference
and left in the quantity being judged. A stationary field exceeds the largest of N
such windows with probability 1/(N+1), so the retained record length sets the
false-refusal rate. The contract declares only that rate, 0.05, which requires 20
windows and 200 retained cycles.

MEASURED on lpj_377476c0, 99 null windows, false-refusal rate 0.010, 64 assessed
fields:

    acceptance window                    cell half   global half
    as run                                0 of 64      1 of 64
    coherent drift at 2x the limit       46 of 64     63 of 64
    cancelling drift at 2x the limit     42 of 64      0 of 64

The last row is the case the guard exists for and the one the global half is blind
to.

WHAT NOW PASSES, AND WHY THAT DID NOT DRIVE IT. lpj_377476c0 passes the per-cell half
on all seven stability tables where it previously failed on three fields. It is still
refused, on one field: lai.out TrIBE, spatial mean 0.0552 over the window at 5.65
standard errors. That is the half the diagnosis showed works, on a type that had not
established at 100 orbits and is still expanding at 1000. The derivation read no
observed fraction from any run: the limits are the null maxima of detrended
surrogates, and every defensible upper-tail choice -- p95, p99 or the maximum --
accepts these runs, so the choice among them is not load-bearing. Only the null
MEDIAN would refuse, and a median is a 50 per cent false-refusal rate.

The two 100-orbit runs are now refused for a different and honest reason: a 100-cycle
record leaves 9 null windows, a 0.10 false-refusal rate against a declared 0.05.
Their remedy is a longer retained record, about 34 minutes at npatch 5, not a
different limit. That run was sized and not taken here, because the remaining
refusal is TrIBE's global drift and a shorter record sits earlier on that trajectory.

THE TREND BLOCK NOW DECLARES, every number with its disposition:
  relative_end_to_end_limit 0.05  DECISION, a declared tolerance; the
    consumer-sensitivity derivation it wants is world-mqzk.
  slope_standard_errors 2.0  DECISION, stated honestly: 8 degrees of freedom makes
    it a two-sided 0.081, not 0.05, and memory in the cycle means raises the achieved
    rate further. The standard error that models no memory is world-ioxr.
  absolute_scale_floor 1e-12  IRREDUCIBLE and provably inert: the tables are
    quantized at 1e-4 or coarser, so the smallest window mean any of them can express
    is 1e-5, every floor in (0, 1e-5) gives identical results, and it binds only where
    the mean is exactly zero and the drift is exactly zero too.
  cell_fraction.null_statistic  DERIVED per field, from the run being judged.
  cell_fraction.maximum_false_refusal_rate 0.05  DECISION at the conventional level;
    it is what sets the retained record length. The ecological bound on that length is
    still owed and is world-3erv.

comments.author: Conor Futro
comments.text:
2026-08-30 DEFECT IN THE CONTRACT I SHIPPED THIS MORNING. vesper-lpj-equilibrium-window/2
declares `maximum_false_refusal_rate: 0.05`. Its ACTUAL run-level false-refusal rate is
0.34. Found by the size arm of world-ioxr's pre-registered sweep, which existed to check
exactly this and is the reason it was registered as a check rather than assumed.

WHAT IS WRONG. The exchangeability argument is correct PER FIELD: a stationary field
exceeds the largest of N detrended null windows with probability 1/(N+1), and at N=99
that is 0.01. But the gate refuses a run when ANY field exceeds its own limit, and there
are 64 assessed fields across the seven stability tables. The run-level rate is
1-(1-1/(N+1))^F_eff, and it is not the declared number.

MEASURED, on lpj_377476c0's 100 detrended windows, leave-one-out so each window is
judged against the other 99 exactly as the contract judges an acceptance window:

     sigma    size    power at 2x the drift limit
     1.000   0.390    1.000
     1.500   0.310    1.000
     2.000   0.340    1.000    <- declared
     2.306   0.290    1.000
     2.500   0.310    1.000
     3.000   0.320    1.000
     4.000   0.300    1.000

Size is flat in sigma, as the construction says it must be, and sits at 0.30 to 0.39
against a declared 0.05. The helper was validated on synthetic fields first: at 100
windows it returns 0.010 for one field, 0.080 for eight and 0.460 for sixty-four
independent ones, against an analytic 1-(1-1/100)^n of 0.010, 0.077 and 0.474. The
measured 0.34 corresponds to about 35 effective independent fields out of 64, the
remainder being the correlated ones -- C3G in lai, fpc and aaet move together.

CONSEQUENCE FOR WHAT WAS ALREADY REPORTED. lpj_377476c0 passing the cell half on all
seven tables is much weaker evidence than it read as: a settled run passes that half
about seven times in ten, not ninety-nine. The refusal that stands, lai.out TrIBE on the
GLOBAL half at 5.65 standard errors, is untouched by this -- the global half has one
test per field and no such multiplicity in the cell construction.

WHY RAISING N DOES NOT FIX IT. A run-level rate of alpha through an empirical
per-window null needs the null to have the resolution to express it. The finest
per-field probability an N-window null can state is 1/(N+1), so the minimum achievable
run-level rate is about F_eff/(N+1). At F_eff 35 and alpha 0.05 that is 710 windows,
7100 retained cycles, roughly 20 hours of model time at npatch 5 -- and it would have to
be re-measured per configuration. The empirical null cannot deliver a conventional rate
on this many fields at any record this project can afford.

WHERE THE REPAIR HAS TO COME FROM, and it is this row's own subject. The empirical null
was forced in the first place because the per-field flag rate under no trend spans
0.001 to 0.40, and the measurement below says why: the bare slope test's flag rate at
sigma 2.0, with the relative-drift condition removed, is 0.47 to 0.72 by table against a
nominal 0.081 for independent samples.

     table              median over fields   worst field
     anpp.out                 0.695          TeNE  0.849
     lai.out                  0.712          TeNE  0.847
     fpc.out                  0.723          TeNE  0.854
     cpool.out                0.676          SoilC 0.766
     npool.out                0.646          Total 0.726
     aaet.out                 0.723          TeNE  0.864
     tot_runoff.out           0.467          Base  0.562

That is the memory this row was filed about, and it is an order of magnitude, not a
correction. If the standard error is repaired so the per-field rate returns to its
nominal value, the null becomes ANALYTIC, an analytic null has unlimited resolution, and
the run-level rate can be controlled at any declared alpha by an ordinary multiplicity
correction. The empirical per-field null would then no longer be needed at all.

So the two rows are one repair, and it is measured next: whether correcting the slope
standard error with `lib/autocorrelation.py`'s integrated autocorrelation time collapses
the per-field null onto its nominal rate. Until that is settled the contract's declared
rate is wrong and is not quietly left standing.

comments.author: Conor Futro
comments.text:
2026-08-30 MEASURED: THE ACCEPTANCE WINDOW IS SHORTER THAN THE THING IT TESTS, AND THE
RECORD IS SHORTER THAN THE APPROACH IT IS WATCHING. Both pre-registered branches of this
row fire, and together they answer world-qcse's original question.

Instrument: `biosphere/scripts/derive_trend_null.py <run> --timescales`, reading
`lib/autocorrelation.py`'s estimator and carrying both of its verdicts rather than
quoting a tau it refuses. Measured on lpj_377476c0, 1000 cycles at fixed forcing, 400
sampled cells per table.

MEMORY. The integrated autocorrelation time of the spatial-mean cycle series, per field,
runs 9.3 to 125.3 cycles. The window the contract tests over is 10. Sixty-one of the 64
assessed fields have a spatial-mean tau longer than the whole window; the per-cell
medians run 2.9 to 93.1, and the share of cells whose own tau exceeds the window is 0.22
to 1.00, at or above 0.85 for most woody types. Representative rows:

    table.field          spatial tau   cell tau median   cells with tau > window
    lai.out BNE                 75.3              64.9                     1.00
    lai.out TrIBE               93.5              63.9                     0.97
    lai.out C3G                  9.9               6.3                     0.36
    cpool.out Total            125.3              68.1                     0.89
    npool.out SoilN             60.6              89.0                     0.87
    tot_runoff.out Total        14.9               5.5                     0.33

A trend test over a span shorter than the memory time is not a trend test. It sees one
excursion of a process that has not had time to sample its own distribution, and the
residuals within the span are small because the process is smooth on that scale, so the
ordinary least-squares standard error is small and the slope looks decisive. That is the
whole of the 0.47 to 0.86 flag rate against a nominal 0.081, and it is
`docs/src/practice/failure-modes.md` class 34 exactly: a bed shorter than its startup.

NO CORRECTION RESCUES IT. Inflating the slope standard error by the square root of tau,
which is the correction `lib/autocorrelation.py` owns, moves lai.out's bare flag rate
from 0.47-0.84 down to 0.19-0.46 -- two to three times better, still two to six times
nominal, and still spanning a factor of four across fields. The correction is for a
MEAN over a span; it cannot make a span shorter than tau carry a trend. Applying the
module's own declared bar, RELIABLE_SPAN_MULTIPLE 10, a valid window would be 10 times
tau, so 100 to 1250 cycles, and twenty such windows is 2000 to 25000 retained cycles.
The windowed trend form cannot be made valid on this model at any affordable cost.

RELAXATION, and this is the substantive answer. An exponential approach fitted to each
field's spatial-mean series over the full 1000 cycles is INADMISSIBLE for most fields by
the criterion declared before it was run: 34 of 64 fits put the asymptote outside the
record's own range, meaning the series has not turned over within 1000 cycles, and three
more return a timescale longer than the record. Where a fit is admissible the e-folding
times are 22.9 to 775.9 cycles, mostly in the hundreds: lai.out TrIBE 685.1, aaet.out
Total 775.9, lai.out TeBS 492.4, lai.out C4G 414.1.

`lib/autocorrelation.py:stationary_enough` independently refuses the spatial-mean series
of most fields: the linear trend across 1000 cycles moves them by more than their own
standard deviation. These series are still moving.

WHAT THE TWO BOUNDS ARE.
 - On the RETAINED record, from the memory time and the module's own span bar: at least
   10 times tau, so 100 to 1250 cycles depending on the field. The statistical bound of
   200 cycles that `maximum_false_refusal_rate: 0.05` implied is NOT the binding one for
   the woody types and the slow pools; the ecological bound is larger.
 - On the SPIN-UP, from the relaxation time: at least a few times an e-folding time of
   several hundred cycles, so of order 2000 to 5000 cycles. `vesper_pfts.ins` sets
   nyear_spinup 998. THE SPIN-UP IS SHORT, by a factor of two to five, and that is why a
   run at literally fixed forcing is still drifting coherently in TrIBE after 1000
   further cycles.

So world-qcse's title is literally true and the reason is now measured: no LPJ run has
reached ecological equilibrium because none has been spun up for long enough, and the
acceptance instrument could not say so because its window was an order of magnitude
shorter than the timescale it was watching.

The time base remains correct and is still not implicated. 998 spin-up cycles is 500.0
Earth years and matches the community convention exactly; the convention is simply too
short for this world's woody types and slow pools.

comments.author: Conor Futro
comments.text:
2026-08-30 THIS ROW'S TITLE WAS WRONG AND IS CORRECTED. It said the time base
is not the reason. The time base CONVERSION is right -- nyear_spinup 998 is
500.0 Earth years and matches LPJ-GUESS's convention exactly -- but the
convention is Earth's, and this world's relaxation time is not Earth's. 34 of
64 exponential fits put the asymptote outside the 1000-cycle record, so the
spin-up is short by a factor of two to five.

What made that invisible for three diagnostic runs is the instrument: the
integrated autocorrelation time of these series is 9.3 to 125.3 cycles against
a 10-cycle window, so the slope was being fitted INSIDE one memory time and was
never a trend test at all. That is why neither more retained time nor more
patches moved the cell fraction -- both were changing a quantity the test could
not see past its own window.

So the earlier conclusions on this row stand as measurements and fall as
diagnoses. The npatch and length sweeps are still correct about what they
measured; what they could not know is that the statistic they were sweeping was
invalid on both settings.

comments.author: Conor Futro
comments.text:
2026-08-30 THE DERIVED SPIN-UP RAN, AND THE MEMORY-TIME FLOOR MOVED UNDER ITSELF. Run lpj_7d3c576ee4e342acb097b46fece976e0: spin-up 2318 cycles, retained record 1253, npatch 5, 1617 cells, 16 ranks. Wall clock about 55 minutes, as derived.

IT DID NOT START ON THE FIRST ATTEMPT AND THAT IS ITS OWN ROW. The built binary predated the source by two days and did not know frac_labile_carbon_humus, so the instruction parser refused an undefined identifier. A change confined to C++ would have run silently on a binary that did not contain it. world-w62x.

THE REFUSAL HAS CHANGED CHARACTER, and this is the result. It is no longer a claim about the biosphere -- no PFT is reported as trending. It is the instrument declaring its own window invalid:

  anpp.out equilibrium refusal: the retained record is too short to judge.
  BNE needs 702 cycles, IBS 1030, TrIBE 949, TrBR 1698, C3G 120.

The acceptance WINDOW is still 10 cycles while every field's memory time is 11 to 213. So the trend is still being fitted inside one memory time, which is the defect the 2026-08-30 19:53 comment measured. THE RECORD WAS RE-DERIVED AND THE WINDOW WAS NOT. Both are spans and the same span multiple governs them; only one was moved.

THE FLOOR MOVES UNDER ITSELF, which the handoff flagged as the thing to watch and which is now measured. Memory times over 64 assessed fields:

  read on the 1000-cycle diagnostic   9.3 to 125.3 cycles  -> record floor 1253
  read on this 1253-cycle record     11.1 to 212.7 cycles  -> record floor 2127

The top rose 70 per cent when the window it is read on grew 25 per cent. The slowest fields are cpool.out Total 212.7, cpool.out VegC 184.1, lai.out TrBR 173.2, anpp.out TrBR 169.8, aaet.out TrBR 162.5. Seven of 64 fields have a 10x span exceeding this record; 57 do not.

WHAT THAT MEANS, and it splits cleanly.
- For 57 of 64 fields the repair needs NO new run: the window is what is wrong, and a per-field window of 10 times that field's own memory time fits inside the record already on disk.
- For 7 fields the record itself is short, and the binding one is cpool.out Total at 2127 cycles. That is a longer run, not a different statistic.
- lib/autocorrelation.py's estimator marks 6 of those 7 NOT reliable, tau being an appreciable fraction of the record, so 212.7 is itself a floor and the next record may raise it again.

THE SELF-REFERENCE IS THE FINDING. A record sized at ten times a memory time read off a shorter record is not self-consistent, and this is the second time it has failed to converge. The disposition is not another guess at a length: either the memory time is estimated by something that does not grow with its window, or the acceptance contract stops requiring a span multiple it cannot establish. That is world-rnns's subject, and the condition its author twice declined to ship without -- a long record -- now exists and answers the question in the negative: lengthening the record did not settle it.

Evidence: biosphere/analysis/lpj_7d3c576ee4e342acb097b46fece976e0/acceptance.json, timescales.tables.

comments.author: Conor Futro
comments.text:
2026-08-31 THE INSTRUMENT IS FIXED AND THE REFUSAL SURVIVED IT. THE BIOSPHERE IS
GENUINELY NOT AT EQUILIBRIUM, AND THE RUN THAT WOULD SETTLE IT IS SIZED.

world-rnns is closed: the acceptance test is now an upper confidence bound on
each field's end-to-end relative drift over the whole retained record
(vesper-lpj-equilibrium-window/4), and its size is validated against series
whose answer is known by construction. So this row's refusals can now be read as
statements about the simulated biosphere rather than about the window.

WHAT THE REFUSAL SAYS NOW, on lpj_7d3c576e's 1253-cycle record. anpp.out alone:

  field   drift    +/-      bound    a settled field of this scatter needs
  IBS     0.1325   0.0863   0.3032   24982 cycles
  TrBR    0.1409   0.1012   0.4758   33846
  TrIBE   0.0984   0.0846   0.2827   25637
  BNS     0.0929   0.0718   0.3040    6792
  TeNE    0.0740   0.0789   0.2074   19288
  C4G     0.0364   0.0327   0.0937    2643
  TeBS    0.0357   0.0241   0.0788    2267
  BNE     0.0008   0.0341   0.0680    3039
  BINE    0.0117   0.0307   0.0742    2821
  TrBE    0.0223   0.0389   0.1292    3410

Five of those have a DRIFT ESTIMATE above the 0.05 tolerance on its own, before
any allowance for uncertainty. That is a real finding and it is the first time
this project has had one: the woody types are still moving after a 2318-cycle
spin-up and a 1253-cycle record at literally fixed forcing. The remaining five
are refused because the record cannot resolve the tolerance, and the refusal
says which is which by carrying both numbers.

THE 57-OF-64 SPLIT IN MY BRIEF IS NOT THE OPERATIVE ONE. Under a valid statistic
the split is about SCATTER, not memory time: the record a field needs goes as its
variance times its memory time, so cpool.out Total at a memory time of 212.7 and
a relative scatter of 0.0055 resolves on the record already on disk, while
anpp.out TrBR at 169.8 and 0.0485 does not until 33846. Twenty-two of the 64
assessed fields resolve on disk -- every Total column, both soil pools, the
grasses, and the one broadleaf evergreen type -- and 42 do not, every one of
them an individual plant functional type's own column.

A RUN IS OWED AND I HAVE NOT LAUNCHED IT. On the assessed set as it stands the
retained record floor is 33846 cycles, about eight and three quarter hours at
npatch 5 on 16 ranks, before any spin-up. DO NOT BUY IT YET: world-mxmr is what
sizes it. The tolerance is derived through ONE consumer-facing quantity --
aggregate tree and grass cover feeding the surface albedo, worth about +0.064 K
-- and the contract applies its number to all 64 fields including every per-PFT
column. On the aggregates alone the record on disk suffices. Deciding the
assessed set is a decision about what the acceptance claim is ABOUT, it is
answerable from the consumers, and it changes the purchase by a factor of
twenty-seven. It must be settled BEFORE the run, not after it, or it is a
criterion chosen by the run it judges.

THE SPIN-UP DERIVATION THIS ROW RESTED ON DOES NOT HOLD, and that is the other
half of the finding. `lib/lpj_output.py:relaxation_time` reads an e-folding time
from the contraction of successive block differences, and `tau = -Q / ln(r)`
diverges as `r` approaches one. It had no condition requiring the contraction to
be RESOLVED. On the 1253-cycle record the model's simulated soil nitrogen
returned 0.992 +/- 0.344 and read out as 37647 cycles; a spin-up from that would
have been about 74000 cycles, nineteen hours. With the condition added, all 192
field-records across the three diagnostic runs are declined -- 97 for
differences that change sign, 82 for a difference inside its own standard error,
and every one of the eight that reached a contraction has an uncertainty
reaching one, the best being 0.584 +/- 0.331.

So THE RELAXATION TIME OF THIS MODEL IS NOT MEASURED, the 59.7-846.8 bracket the
2318-cycle spin-up came from was not supported, and this row's title claim --
that the spin-up is short by two to five times the relaxation time -- has no
measurement behind it. It may still be true; nothing on disk establishes it.
`ecological_run_cycles` now returns no spin-up and names the estimator and the
count, `build_vesper_pfts.py` falls back to the rescaled convention recording
that reason, and the gate checks the ABSENCE the same way it checks a
derivation, so a default fails where a number would.

The RECORD floor is unaffected and is derived, because it never depended on the
relaxation time. Making the two independent is what let it be derived at all.

VERDICT: this row stays OPEN and its acceptance criterion is unchanged and not
met. No LPJ run is accepted. What has changed is that the refusal is now
trustworthy, the length that would answer it is computed and written onto every
acceptance artifact whatever the verdict, and the two things blocking the
purchase are named: world-mxmr sizes it, and the spin-up that precedes it has no
derivation until a record long enough to resolve a block difference exists.

The three diagnostic runs are re-assessed under /4; their acceptance artifacts
carry the drift bound and the resolving length per field.
